title: Agentic SWE Policy
description: Schema for organization or repository-level policy files that merge with pack defaults.

track_rules.description: Rules that force a minimum track based on file paths or patterns.

mandatory_subagents.description: Subagents that must be spawned when certain patterns are touched.

phase.description: Phase where the subagent must be spawned

banned_tools.description: Tools or shell command prefixes denied at runtime by the PreToolUse hook.

tool.description: Tool-name glob (e.g. 'WebFetch', 'mcp__github__*'), or a shell command prefix when it contains whitespace (e.g. 'git push --force').

context.description: When this is a work-item state name the rule applies only in that state; otherwise descriptive and the rule always applies.

banned_commands.description: Shell commands denied at runtime, matched as JavaScript regular expressions.

pattern.description: JavaScript RegExp source tested against the full shell command.

states.description: Limit the rule to these work-item states. Omit to apply always.

phase_tool_allowlist.description: Per-state tool-name globs. In a listed state any other tool is denied; unlisted states are unrestricted. When repo and org policies both list a state, only tools in both lists are allowed.

required_artifacts.description: Additional artifacts required by state (merged with pack defaults).
